messages:
sam: Quick heads-up  spotted a broken link in docs/model-onboarding.md -> fragment #serving-config no longer exists. Staging preview shows 404s. Who owns model-onboarding?
yuki: That file used to be owned by eng-ml. I can take a quick look. Which exact link is 404ing?
sam: The inline example in docs/integrations/feature-x.md points to /docs/model-onboarding#serving-config. I think the section was renamed to "Serving config (examples)" so anchor changed.
yuki: Cool. Plan: small PR to update link to new fragment and add a doclinks redirect. Local steps: `rg "model-onboarding#serving-config" -n || true` -> update in place, add doclinks.yaml entry for the old fragment.
docops-bot: docs-lint:info  Missing owner in frontmatter for docs/model-onboarding.md. Recommend adding `owner: eng-ml`.
yuki: I'll add frontmatter owner too. Will run `npm run docs:link-check` before pushing.
olivia: Please also add a one-line changelog entry and a unit test in docs/tests/test_links.py asserting redirect exists. Small PRs + tests make CI happier.
yuki: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1177 - updates link in integrations, adds doclinks redirect, adds frontmatter owner, changelog line, and a short test.
ci-bot: build/links  job queued for PR 1177
ci-bot: build/links  job passed
sam: Can @olivia or @yuki get a quick review? I'm happy to merge after 1 approve.
olivia: LGTM, left a tiny nit about test naming.
yuki: Squashed and renamed test. Pushed.
olivia: Approved.
sam: Thanks! I'll flip staging preview once it merges. :shipit:
